punchline: Harari says modern censorship does not hide facts, it buries them under so much noise that you cannot tell which ones matter.
thirty_sec: Harari opens 21 Lessons with the idea that in a flood of irrelevant information, clarity is power, and that censorship now works by flooding people with disinformation and distractions. On fake news, he says a story a thousand people believe for a month is fake news, and one a billion people believe for a thousand years is a religion. His practical advice is that if you want reliable information, be ready to pay for it.
